injuries.name: CJ McCollum
injuries.detail: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Jayson Tatum
injuries.detail: Tatum (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Derrick White
injuries.detail: White (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.detail: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.detail: Smith (illness) has been upgraded to probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Patrick Williams
injuries.detail: Williams is probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a left thumb sprain.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: P.J. Washington
injuries.detail: Washington (illness/shoulder) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.detail: Cunningham (knee) is probable to play Sunday in Atlanta.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Ronald Holland II
injuries.detail: Holland (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Atlanta.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.detail: Okorie (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Atlanta.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Pascal Siakam
injuries.detail: Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday's game in New York.

injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.detail: Antetokounmpo (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Myron Gardner
injuries.detail: Gardner (hamstring) is probable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.detail: Anunoby (calf) won't play Sunday against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
injuries.detail: Towns (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.detail: Clarkson (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
injuries.detail: Gilgeous-Alexander (back/neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus Miami.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Alex Caruso
injuries.detail: Caruso (hip) won't play Sunday against the Heat.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) is listed as out for Sunday's game against Miami.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus the Heat.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Bub Carrington
injuries.detail: Carrington (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the Magic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Deandre Ayton
injuries.detail: Ayton (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against Orlando.
